item.title: Debugging Foundry hosted agents v2 with Python
item.description:
Introduction

The new azd ai agent init command provisions a Python project targeting Microsoft Foundry. Out of the box, this is a great way to get started quickly, but one friction point immediately emerges: pressing F5 in Visual Studio Code does not work. The project lacks the VS Code configuration file needed for debugging.

Thankfully, this is a quick fix.

The solution

One configuration file needs to be added to the .vscode folder at the root of your workspace.

item.title: Debugging Foundry hosted agents v2 with dotnet and Microsoft Agent Framework
item.description:
Introduction

The new azd ai agent init command provisions a dotnet project using the Microsoft Agent Framework targeting Microsoft Foundry. Out of the box, this is a great way to get started quickly, but one friction point immediately emerges: pressing F5 in Visual Studio Code does not work. The project lacks the VS Code configuration files needed for debugging.

Thankfully, this is a quick fix.

The solution

Two configuration files need to be added to the .vscode folder at the root of your workspace.
